question: Which familiar physics structures are being assumed before they emerge from X4 and Y14=Met(X), and which branch architecture is more likely to reach a coherent source action with honestly priced external datum?

odds_scope.conditional_event: one of the two present branch architectures reaches a coherent geometry-first source action and honestly priced external datum
not_probability_of: the Standard Model emerging from dimension four alone

lens_odds.reason: G1 graph-owns the moving reference and derivative cocycle, but P/H/A remain supplied
guided separates the nontrivial derivative cocycle from its compensating field-space enlargement, though generic cocycle packaging has limited physical selection power
G3 derives presymplectic and partial BV data from the written action while the control installs more of its BV skeleton before the full symmetry/boundary complex
G2/G3 let exact variation kill the desired shortcut and force coupled Ward closure
both share the native Krein advances; the control owns more matter detail while guided has cleaner graph ownership
guided now owns the pullback/leakage/domain question; neither has solved it
guided preserves right-H geometry without preselecting P0, while control has stronger completed branching but more upstream physicalization
guided may derive the physical complex target-blind, but control has more mature P3, index, and domain-obstruction infrastructure
guided can derive stabilizer, Higgs, and fermionic operator before scoring SM agreement, while control preloads substantial Yang-Mills/Yukawa structure
guided can still derive stress, conservation, state, and amplitude from one distortion action, while control depends more on inserted Lambda, scalar, defect, and fitted-amplitude templates

odds_reporting_policy.reason: the ten specialists answer different mathematical questions and their judgments must not be collapsed into one pseudo-consensus probability
odds_reporting_policy.comparison_axis: each row separately estimates geometry-first source-action and datum coherence from that specialist's own domain
odds_reporting_policy.recognizable_physics_speed: not scored because inserting familiar templates makes speed incomparable to emergence

decisive_tests: enumerate target-blind natural bundles, equivariant maps, and local invariant 14-forms at bounded differential order
ablate N1 curvature-square, SW, Yukawa/flavor, bare-Lambda, and defect terms and test which re-emerge from the native action, Hessian, pullback, or elimination
construct G4 lift/retract/domain without SM, chirality, generation, or PP3 labels and test off-slice leakage
derive the fermionic Dirac/RS operator from the source-action Hessian and G4 domain rather than inserting its coefficient matrix
derive or sharply classify the physical gauging of P, H, and A from natural automorphisms of the metric-bundle spin/Krein structure
prove an auxiliary-field/reduction/replacement equivalence between G2 and retained N1 terms or record genuine double counting
freeze the stabilizer before enumerating U(1) lines; only then run hypercharge and anomaly tests
make one parent action emit the heavy Higgs and light cosmological modes, their stress, and normalization without an independent vacuum offset
rank independent constraints against all declared freedoms only after the action, domain, state, and projections are frozen
